content: Read-only AWS EKS APIs in us-east-1 reported Kubernetes 1.34 STANDARD_SUPPORT through 2026-12-02, extended support through 2027-12-02, patch 1.34.11; describe-addon-versions returned compatible candidates vpc-cni v1.23.2-eksbuild.3, kube-proxy v1.34.6-eksbuild.49, CoreDNS v1.13.2-eksbuild.51, Pod Identity Agent v1.4.0-eksbuild.4, and EBS CSI v1.67.0-eksbuild.1 on 2026-10-14.
